originality.rationale: Structural exact fractional-additivity law and the simultaneous ordinary count are absent from the fully inspected 2026 universal-bound paper, inspected 2020 product theorem and 2022 convex-hull estimates; the closest accessible records do not imply the claim because products differ from free sums. The 2025 direct-sum title has unread full text and is retained as a real priority risk rather than negative evidence. Novelty is a best-knowledge scholarly determination, not proof of worldwide uniqueness.
residual_risks: Full text of Lyu–Gao–Chen–Wu (2025) on covering unit balls of direct sums was not accessible; possible ordinary-law overlap is unresolved, and no stronger fractional assertion can be excluded without inspection.
Full texts of Boltyanski–Martini 2007 and Baladze–Boltyanski 2006 were not accessible; their abstracts concern direct-vector sums, usually products.
An older or differently indexed exact weighted free-sum formula could exist; unsuccessful searches do not certify historical priority.
